episode_summary: In this episode, Frances Katzen shares her insights on the impact of the Pietta Tear Tax on New York's real estate market, the importance of having a strong opinion, and how to leverage media presence effectively. She also discusses how her discipline from ballet has influenced her real estate career, offering valuable lessons on consistency and resilience.
